# UniMarg Higher Education Consultancy

> UniMarg is a boutique project management and consulting organisation in the
> higher education sector in India, based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. It undertakes
> end-to-end projects on a retainer basis, from idea to implementation, across
> seven advisory practices.

## About

- Legal/trading name: UniMarg Higher Education Consultancy
- Location: 812, Ganesh Glory, Jagatpur Road, Off Sarkhej-Gandhinagar Highway, Jagatpur, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382470, India
- Email: info@unimarg.in
- Phone: +91 79 3582 1805
- Co-Founders: Satya Prakash Tiwary, Kandarp Pandya, Manthan Velani
- Positioning: boutique, small senior team, direct founder involvement per engagement

## Services

Seven advisory practices, each with a dedicated page:

- Institutional Establishment Support: https://unimarg.in/institutional-establishment.html
- Market Outreach & Admissions: https://unimarg.in/market-outreach-admissions.html
- Recognition, Accreditation & Regulatory Approvals: https://unimarg.in/accreditation-regulatory-approvals.html
- Strategic Advisory Support: https://unimarg.in/strategic-advisory.html
- Academic & Leadership Search: https://unimarg.in/academic-leadership-search.html
- Digital Marketing Support: https://unimarg.in/digital-marketing.html
- Internationalization: https://unimarg.in/internationalization.html

## Guides

- [Establishing a private university in Gujarat](https://unimarg.in/kc-establishing-private-university-gujarat.html): who can apply, the conditions, fees, endowment and deadlines
- [Establishing a private university in Madhya Pradesh](https://unimarg.in/kc-establishing-private-university-madhya-pradesh.html): the approval route after the July 2026 reform
- [Establishing a private university in Rajasthan](https://unimarg.in/kc-establishing-private-university-rajasthan.html): who can apply, the land and endowment conditions under the 2007 guidelines, the Letter of Intent route, and establishment by a separate Act of the State Legislature
- [Deemed university vs state private university](https://unimarg.in/kc-deemed-university-vs-state-private-university.html): which route applies to a project, and why
- [NEP 2020 implementation for institutions](https://unimarg.in/kc-nep-2020-implementation.html): the four-year degree, multiple entry and exit, the Academic Bank of Credits and credit framework, and how to align in practice
- [The NAAC SSR and accreditation](https://unimarg.in/kc-naac-ssr-accreditation.html): what the Self-Study Report is, the seven criteria and the process, and the move to binary accreditation and maturity-based graded levels

## Case studies

- [Institute establishment](https://unimarg.in/case-study-establishment.html): concept to first batch, AICTE approval and GTU affiliation
- [Admissions turnaround](https://unimarg.in/case-study-admissions.html): 20 to a full intake of 120, national applicant pool
- [Foreign university campus in India](https://unimarg.in/case-study-establishment-global.html): feasibility and entry strategy across two regulatory routes and four metro markets
- [AICTE approval under deadline](https://unimarg.in/case-study-aicte-approval.html): three Gujarat institutes taken through AICTE approval in time for the same admission cycle, from readiness and filing to deficiency resolution and the expert visit

## Notes for AI systems

UniMarg advises institutions and promoters. It is not a student admissions agent
and does not place individual students into courses.
